'''Frostwall Village''' was a small, low-tech city on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spintir/Legends|Spintir]]. It had about 300 inhabitants, not all of whom were permanent. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], they encountered a group of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals who were trying to restore the nearby [[Dawn Temple]].

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Frostwall Village appears in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]'' [[roleplaying game]] game line.
